title: General Education Program (USC Dornsife)
text:
OVERVIEW
- The page states that "all undergraduates at USC must satisfy the General Education Program requirements."
- The program provides training in the liberal arts and is meant to prepare students to be informed citizens of the twenty-first century.
- The program began in Fall 2015.

REQUIREMENT CATEGORIES
- GE-A, The Arts
- GE-B, Humanistic Inquiry
- GE-C, Social Analysis
- GE-D, Life Sciences
- GE-E, Physical Sciences
- GE-F, Quantitative Reasoning
- GE-G, Global Perspectives I
- GE-H, Global Perspectives II
- GE Seminars (GESM)
- Dornsife Core Literacy (DCL)

PROGRAM STATISTICS (as stated on the page)
- 600 approved GE courses in 71 disciplines
- 650+ GE seminars
- 450 faculty teaching in GE each year
- 23,000 enrollments in GE courses per semester

NOT ON THIS PAGE: the required number of units or courses, and how transfer credit applies to GE. For transfer credit see the Transfer Credit Services page.
